name: 24387-imageprefill-qwen25vl7b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 -- two GPUs of one node, no fabric between hosts.
parallelism: PP=2, TP=1, DP=1, mp executor, V1 engine core, one engine served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend. 14 language-model layers per stage.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 800 requests with a 1200 s safety cap; static seed 24387. 640 requests land inside the scored window -- warmup is request-bounded and discards 160, the cooldown is a duration phase that a request-bounded run of this length never reaches.
workload: single-turn image chat synthesised by guidellm from two --data sources: synthetic_text pinned at 24 prompt tokens and 8 output tokens, and synthetic_image at 720p (1280x720), 1 image per request, jpeg, jpeg_quality 85, content gradient. temperature 0.0. Every row's image is distinct, so nothing in the stack can memoise one across requests.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant for single 720p photos with brief replies, serving four concurrent users across two GPUs.
launch:
# Serve configuration for a 2x H100 80GB HBM3 node.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
pipeline-parallel-size: 2
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned, not defaulted: mp IS this engine's default for a 2-GPU single-node world, but the
# default selection consults whether ray is importable and ray is present in the venv.
distributed-executor-backend: mp

dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
